messages.subject: Worker stopped without reporting
messages.body:
Worker structworker_00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000081 ended its turn without sending worker_done for task "示例任务" (task_000000000082).
The Dispatch is still open. Answer it with your Orca CLI's `orchestration send --to dispatch:ctx_000000000083 --subject "<topic>" --body "<guidance>"`, retry it, or stop the worker.
If it is idle on purpose, leave it: its later idle turns are not reported until you write to it.
